NOTHING WAS ADDED TO THIS MAP: the map is reviewed territory, and a slot found by colour is a candidate for the human reading it, not a change made on its behalf.

SENDABLE FORMAT (Joe's doctrine, 2026-07-31, superseding the old blanket 'clients get PDFs, never working files'): this is a LETTER template, so the WORKING .docx is what goes to the listing agent. They edit and revise it, and that revision IS the negotiation; the PDF is the record and preview copy. Because the .docx is outbound it is SCRUBBED before it routes, of comments, tracked changes, comment authors, custom properties and the authorship metadata inherited from CARR's corporate letterhead. Naming a sendable format is not itself an ask to send: it goes out when Joe asks (decision 41906a30).

purchase_price.label: Purchase Price
purchase_price.owed_note: THE SCHEMA GAP HAS AN ANSWER (ORDER 24b, 2026-07-31). Migration 0022_purchase_price_basis.sql widens negotiation_round.rate_basis with usd_total (a total purchase price) and usd_sf_total (a total price stated per SF), alongside the four rent bases it already carried. THE RULE FOR THIS SLOT: it fills from the NEWEST buyer-side negotiation round carrying either purchase basis, rendered as usd. A rent basis never fills it and a price is never derived from a rent, because the two answer different questions. THREE GATES STILL STAND BETWEEN THE VOCABULARY AND A FILLED SLOT, listed rather than improvised (full site list in ORDER 24's execution log): (1) 0022 is proven on Neon branch rehearse-0022 and is NOT yet applied to production, which is Joe's tap; (2) record-counter's rate_basis enum in mcp-server/src/tools.js still offers the four rent bases only, so no verb can write a purchase round yet; (3) the plan generator's record bag hardcodes round.purchase_price to null, so the slot owes even once a round exists. Until all three clear this slot owes on every purchase deal, which is the right behaviour: a purchase price is reported, never invented.
